capabilities: Convert a note, folder or whole vault to Word, Excel or PDF
Combine several notes into one document with cover page and table of contents
Export note tables, tasks and frontmatter into Excel workbooks
Save Mermaid diagrams as SVG or PNG images
Set output folder, file naming and overwrite behavior
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js file APIs, so it does not run on mobile). Dataview and dataviewjs blocks are rendered by Obsidian, so dataviewjs code in converted notes is executed. PDF export temporarily switches Obsidian to the light theme, and PDF tables of contents have no page numbers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into Word, Excel or PDF files, and doing it note by note is slow.

relations.evidence: The Dataview plugin must be installed for these blocks to be converted.

summary: Plugin that batch-converts notes, folders or a whole vault to Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) and PDF, rendering Mermaid diagrams as images.
